content.study:
Article 2A (“Sikkim to be associated with the Union”) of the Constitution of India has been omitted by constitutional amendment.

Status: Repealed / Omitted.
It is not current working law in the territory of India.

Examination Instruction:
When answering university or judicial service questions, note that Article 2A is omitted and identify the living constitutional or statutory provision that currently governs the subject matter.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Explain the constitutional status and historical context of Article 2A (Sikkim to be associated with the Union).
questionsAndAnswers.answer:
I. INTRODUCTION & STATUS
Article 2A of the Constitution of India (“Sikkim to be associated with the Union”) is omitted. It does not form part of the living, enforceable constitutional text.

II. HISTORICAL BACKGROUND
The provision was repealed/omitted by constitutional amendment to remove obsolete structures, harmonize constitutional governance, or eliminate transitional provisions.

III. CURRENT GOVERNING HEADING
Examinees must identify the living provision that now regulates this field (e.g. general powers of Parliament, corresponding statutory enactments, or alternative constitutional mechanisms).

IV. CONCLUSION
Cite Article 2A strictly as a repealed/omitted heading. Do not apply its text to contemporary 2026 dispute scenarios.
